description: §14.8.9 — no false positive: a NON-protected field read off the same protected row (`return u.name`) compiles (no E-PROTECT-006) and crosses the wire. RUNTIME: the E-ADAPTER server-eval runs the real emitted route and the client cell holds "Alice".
rationale: The S441 provenance flow (g-protected-column-escapes-redaction-as-scalar) rejects a value whose provenance is a protected column; `name` is not one, so extracting it is the ordinary, correct shape and must not fire. Twin of `scalar-return-e006` (same row, the protected column instead). Nothing reaches the sink as a row, so I-PROTECT-STRIP-001 does not fire either — the floor stripped nothing.
